messages.subject: 求解迴圈和ggplot的error
messages.body_plain:
for(i in c(1:50)){
  abc <- as.vector(tudo2[i+1, 2:20])
  sp = c(rep(1, times = 6), rep(2, times = 5), rep(3, times = 3), rep(4, times = 5))
  abc <- as.numeric(abc)
  lm.exp <- lm(abc~sp)
  output <- aov(lm.exp)
  summary(output);
  dt <- data.frame(name = c("AL", "DR" ,"FAL", "FDR"),
                   value = c(average(tudo2[i+1,2:7]), average(tudo2[i+1,8:12]), average(tudo2[i+1,13:15]), average(tudo2[i+1,16:20])),
                   sd = c(se(tudo2[i+1,2:7]), se(tudo2[i+1,8:12]), se(tudo2[i+1,13:15]), se(tudo2[i+1,16:20])))
  ade <-pairwise.t.test(as.numeric(tudo2[i+1, 2:20]), sp, p.adj = "none")$p.value
  A <- matrix(nrow = 51, ncol = 6)
  A[i+1,1] <- ade[1,1]
  A[i+1,2:3] <- ade[2,1:2]
  A[i+1,4:6] <- ade[3,1:3]
  tudo2 <- cbind(tudo2,A);
  plot1 <- ggplot(data = dt, aes(name, value))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, fill = "red", "blue", "yellow", "black")+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value-sd, ymax = value+sd), width = .2, position = position_dodge(.9))+
    if (tudo2[i+1,21] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =1.5, y = 2, label = "*")}+
    if (tudo2[i+1,22] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =2, y = 3, label = "*")}+
    if (tudo2[i+1,23] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =2.5, y = 2, label = "*")}+
    if (tudo2[i+1,24] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =3, y = 3, label = "*")}+
    if (tudo2[i+1,25] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =3.5, y = 3, label = "*")}+
    if (tudo2[i+1,26] < 0.05){annotate("text", x =4, y = 2, label = "*")}
}
